summary: Validated VideoPick iOS-Safari MediaRecorder fix + backend codec-suffixed Content-Type acceptance. All 6 backend tests pass; frontend end-to-end recording flow (sign-in → profile → Change intro → record → stop → playback) works with no NotSupportedError and no silent failures.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoPick.js fix is correct: pickRecorderMime probes candidates in the right order (prefers webm on desktop Chrome, falls back to video/mp4 for iOS Safari, and to browser default if all fail). MediaRecorder creation is properly wrapped in try/catch with a user-facing toast. Blob type strips codec suffix via mimeType.split(';')[0].

Backend upload_video_file correctly normalizes codec-suffixed Content-Types via `.split(';')[0].strip().lower()` before ALLOWED lookup, and passes the normalized ctype to GCS upload_from_file — clean and forward-compatible.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo-00 session. Test uploads went to gs://nicemeechu/user_videos/<demo-00-id>.{mp4,webm} — note demo-00's real intro was overwritten with a 4KB dummy during codec tests (intended for regression validation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for the codec fix lives at /app/backend/tests/test_video_upload_codec.py — run with pytest. Frontend Playwright test at /app/tests/test_videopick_ui.py requires chromium launch args --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream and --use-fake-device-for-media-stream (already set) and must dismiss the cookie banner (Accept button) before clicking nav-profile — otherwise the banner intercepts subsequent clicks. VideoPick testids: video-pick-screen, record-toggle-button, record-countdown, record-playback-video, record-retake-button, video-save-button, profile-change-video (on ProfileScreen).
rca of the issue: Confirmed via code review + tests: the pre-fix bug was `new MediaRecorder(stream, {mimeType: 'video/webm'})` throwing NotSupportedError on iOS Safari (only supports mp4), with no try/catch — record button silently no-op'd. Fix correctly probes isTypeSupported for webm variants first, falls back to mp4 (iOS), and falls back to browser default; wraps constructor in try/catch with toast; strips codec suffix from blob type. Backend companion fix normalizes codec-suffixed Content-Types (previously 415 on 'video/mp4;codecs=avc1...').
